name: typography
title: Typography
description: Typography scale definitions, utilities, and composition patterns for the Aura design system. Includes structured data for LLM consumption with HTML/JSX examples.

export type TypographySection = 'Text' | 'Marketing' | 'Code'; export type TypographyItem = (typeof typographyScale)[number]; /** * Get all typography items for a specific section */ export function getTypographyBySection( section: TypographySection ): TypographyItem[] { return typographyScale.filter((t) => t.section === section); } /** * Find a typography item by name and optional section */ export function findTypography( name: string, section?: TypographySection ): TypographyItem | undefined { return typographyScale.find( (t) => t.name === name && (!section || t.section === section) ); } /** * For LLM consumption - typography examples with HTML/JSX code */ export const typographyExamples = typographyScale.map((t) => ({ ...t, htmlExample: `
